description: Submits a decomposed group of OMP tasks to execute concurrently in the server-side bounded rolling pool (max_parallel 1-10) using a detached group runner. Enforces dependency DAG and write-ownership safety, waits up to wait_seconds (0-240, default 60s) for batch completion, and returns stable compact aggregated results. If still running when deadline elapses, returns group_id and minimal progress counts for subsequent omp_wait_group.

cwd.description: Absolute working directory OMP may inspect and modify

default_max_attempts.description: Default per-task attempt limit if not specified in task (1-5, default 3)

default_timeout_minutes.description: Default per-task timeout in minutes if not specified in task (1-120, default 30)

group_timeout_minutes.description: Hard overall group deadline in minutes (1-120, default 60)

max_parallel.description: Maximum concurrent active OMP runners (1-10, default 4)

supervisor_brief.description: Shared decision-ready read-only findings, hypotheses, and constraints for the task group

tasks.description: Array of decomposed tasks to execute concurrently according to dependency DAG and ownership safety

goal.description: Complete natural-language outcome OMP must deliver

id.description: Unique task identifier within the group

ownership.description: Workspace paths this task is authorized to write to (required non-empty for write tasks)

wait_seconds.description: Maximum seconds to wait for batch completion inside this call (0-240, default 60)

name: omp_run_batch_compact
title: Run Batch OMP Tasks with DAG and Compact Aggregated Result (Preferred for Multi-task)
